text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 2664507890 High error rate: route=checkout-canary policy=smart-routing fallback=region-eu-west event=evict-loop
Maria: paging SRE, canary is spiking 5xxs and routing is bouncing between us-east and eu-west.
Arjun: oncall here, taking it. what's impact? customer-facing checkout requests?
Tom: yes, checkout latency 2-5s and 10% 5xx for canary traffic (~3% overall). Some sessions see content mismatch.
Jess: seeing variant mismatch logs: caller routed to variant v2-quant then sticky fallback returns v1-ptq. might be model variant mismatch on fallback.
Priya: that would explain content drift and errors — our fallback policy is configured to sticky-affinity+region-fallback, TTL 30s.
Arjun: reproducing: when canary backend returns 503, router marks host down then starts fallback to region eu-west with variant fallback=v1, but sticky tickets reassign back shortly -> eviction thrash.
Maria: can someone run `redwoodctl routing status --route checkout-canary` ?
Tom: pasted output:
```
route: checkout-canary
policy: smart-routing
sticky_affinity: enabled
fallbacks: [regional-eu-west(v1), global(v1)]
bindings: us-east(v2-quant) -> eu-west(v1) -> us-east(v2-quant) ...
```
Arjun: confirmed loop. rolling pause of canary now.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: `redwoodctl rollout pause --id canary-2026-03` by Arjun
Arjun: paused. canary traffic dropped to 0%.
Jess: mitigation idea: disable sticky_affinity for this route temporarily so fallbacks pick local compatible variant.
Priya: also adjust fallback priority to prefer same-variant-compatible instances. Changing now.
Tom: made change: `redwoodctl routing update --route checkout-canary --sticky=false --fallback-priority=variant-match`
deploy-bot: routing update applied
Maria: metrics: 5xxs falling, error rate back to baseline in 7m. Latency normalizing.
Arjun: oncall handoff: Arjun -> Priya for follow-up. Priya you ok to own postmortem?
Priya: taking. will investigate why canary hosts returning 503s (resource pressure?) and why sticky wasn't variant-aware.
Jess: opening PSC ticket for customer impact: some checkout sessions may have gotten old-variant semantics for ~15m. I'll draft customer note.
Maria: assigning P0 for runtime to research: possible kernel regression in v2-quant that causes overload with certain sequences.
Arjun: adding temporary rule: when fallback occurs, attach header `x-fallback-reason=evict-loop` and rate-limit retries for same session.
Tom: added firewall/ratelimit tweak via `nginx` rule for the path.
Priya: will coordinate rollback if we see regression on v2-quant after deeper test. For now, rollout remains paused.
Maria: good work. logging follow-ups: create incident ticket and include logs, routing config, timeline.
Priya: will own incident ticket and schedule postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT. tagging ops and runtime.
incident-bot: incident acknowledged, pager cleared.
